JewelryModels pack - licences and attribution
Fetched and generated October 14, 2026; revised October 15, 2026 (RingSapphireHalo and WatchDressSteel rebuilt,
RingAntiqueTigerEye rescaled, metallic-smoothness maps regenerated; EarringsDiamondStuds, NecklaceBust, both pearl
strands, GemParcel, both ring boxes and JewelersLoupe rebuilt so that no part floats; see README.md). Machine-readable
list with SHA-256 per file: sources.json.

======================================================================
1. ORIGINAL PROJECT-OWNED ASSETS (most of the pack)
======================================================================
Files: every model, material and texture NOT listed in sections 2 and 3, i.e.
  Ring{SolitaireDiamond,GoldBand,SapphireHalo,DiamondEternity,RubyThreeStone}, Earrings{DiamondStuds,GoldHoops},
  Necklace{Bust,PearlDraped,PearlDropped,PendantDraped,PendantDropped}, BraceletTennisDiamond, BangleGold,
  WatchDressSteel, WatchPillow, Gem{RoundBrilliant,PrincessCut,EmeraldCut,OvalSapphire,CushionRuby,PearDiamond,Parcel},
  RingCone, EarringStand, RingBox{Open,Closed}, PriceTag01-04, PriceStand01-04, GiftBag, GiftBox, GoldBar1kg,
  GoldBar100g, GoldCoin, JewelersLoupe, PaymentTerminal, PosTablet (.obj/.mtl), the textures WatchDial_Color.png,
  PriceTags_Color.png, GoldBar1kg_{Color,Normal}.png, GoldBar100g_{Color,Normal}.png, GoldCoin_{Color,Normal}.png,
  GiftBag_Color.png, PaymentTerminal_Color.png, PosTablet_Screen.png, GemPaper_Color.png, and everything in Source~/
  (Source~/Preview.jpg also shows renders of the four third-party models below; their licences apply to those tiles).
Author: Jewelry-store-vr-demo project (generated with Claude, an AI assistant, from the Python scripts in Source~/).
Licence: project-owned original work; no third-party restrictions. No third-party geometry, photographs or
  scans were used. All brand text is the project's fictional shop "Aurel & Finch" (see NightGraphics); the coin,
  bar stamps, dial, tags, bag, terminal and till screens are original designs and do not reproduce any real
  currency, refiner, watch maker, payment network or retailer.
Fonts used only to rasterise text into the textures (the fonts themselves are not shipped):
  Caladea (c) 2012 The Caladea Project Authors - SIL Open Font License 1.1
  Barlow (c) The Barlow Project Authors - SIL Open Font License 1.1 (already in Prototype/ThirdParty/Fonts)
  The OFL does not restrict images made with the fonts.

======================================================================
2. CC0 / PUBLIC DOMAIN
======================================================================
PocketWatchVintage.obj/.mtl, PocketWatchVintage_Color.jpg, PocketWatchVintage_Normal.png,
PocketWatchVintage_MetallicSmoothness.png
  Title:   Vintage Pocket Watch (asset id vintage_pocket_watch)
  Author:  Tal Swicegood, published by Poly Haven
  Source:  https://polyhaven.com/a/vintage_pocket_watch
  Licence: CC0 1.0 Universal (public domain dedication) - https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
           Poly Haven publishes all of its assets under CC0 (https://polyhaven.com/license).
  Obtained from: an unmodified copy of the Poly Haven 2k glTF in a GitHub repository (polyhaven.com is not reachable
           from the build machine): https://github.com/QueenOfSquiggles/squiggle-pt
           commit deabff55b5df0b8989e58400bdf05de1c8e1eae1,
           Game/Assets/Models/Decoration/vintage_pocket_watch_2k.gltf + vintage_pocket_watch.bin +
           textures/vintage_pocket_watch_{diff,nor_gl,arm}_2k.jpg (Poly Haven file naming, Blender glTF I/O 1.6.16
           export as on Poly Haven). Author/title also cross-checked against the Poly Haven model catalogue.
  Changes: decimated from 16,098 to about 8,000 triangles (Tools/glb_to_obj.py), laid face up, metres; diffuse
           resized to 1024 JPG, normal map resized to 1024 PNG, ARM map converted to a Unity metallic-smoothness
           map (R = metallic, A = 1 - roughness, 512 px; regenerated October 15 with the per-channel converter in
           Source~/maps.py from the same file, re-fetched from the same commit); glass and hands given plain materials.
  Attribution: not required ("Vintage Pocket Watch by Tal Swicegood, Poly Haven, CC0" given as a courtesy).

======================================================================
3. CC BY 4.0 - ATTRIBUTION REQUIRED (keep these lines with the demo, e.g. in its credits)
======================================================================
Licence text: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International - https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
Each source repository contained the Sketchfab download notice (license.txt) and the same licence in the glTF
asset metadata (asset.extras.license = "CC-BY-4.0"). Sketchfab itself is not reachable from the build machine,
so the licence was taken from those Sketchfab-generated notices. The attribution is also written as a comment at
the top of each OBJ file.

RingAntiqueTigerEye.obj/.mtl, RingAntiqueTigerEye_Color.jpg, RingAntiqueTigerEye_Normal.png,
RingAntiqueTigerEye_MetallicSmoothness.png
  Attribution: "An Old Ring" (https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/an-old-ring-ea5e0c11f2e046c993239ea1a3efcad7)
               by Qifan Zhang (https://sketchfab.com/qifanzhang), licensed under CC BY 4.0. Modified.
  Obtained from: https://github.com/mhh-hazrati8068/nafis-jewellary commit 0d857d9d8bdb61e5130d5683344db44a71db4e9b,
               public/models/an_old_ring/ (scene.gltf, scene.bin, textures/, license.txt)
  Changes: decimated 19,092 -> 7,000 triangles; re-oriented (finger axis X, stone up); scaled to metres
           (26.3 mm across, 17.1 mm inner diameter like the procedural rings; rescaled October 15 from the first
           21.5 mm conversion); textures resized (colour 1024 JPG; normal and metallic-smoothness 512 PNG, the
           metallic-smoothness map converted per channel with Source~/maps.py).

EarringPearlDrop.obj/.mtl, EarringPearlDrop_Color.jpg, EarringPearlDrop_Normal.png,
EarringPearlDrop_MetallicSmoothness.png
  Attribution: "Earring Jade" (https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/earring-jade-c91e552728fb4b149d52193fd3e03ac5)
               by Softmind Game Factory (https://sketchfab.com/softmind), licensed under CC BY 4.0. Modified.
  Obtained from: https://github.com/hiukim/mind-ar-js commit fb5db87b1e5076ba86fde82101955da70b629a1c,
               examples/face-tracking/assets/earring/ (scene.gltf, scene.bin, textures/, license.txt); the same
               scene.bin (sha256 2a952441...0a80c) is also in mykolalehkyi/FittingAccessoriesAndHeadwear.
  Changes: decimated 11,832 -> 7,000 triangles; scaled to 40 mm (metres); colour and normal maps resized; the
           metallic-smoothness map is a new map derived from the colour map (gold metallic 1, pearls 0, smoothness
           0.71 = 1 - the glTF roughnessFactor 0.292), because the upstream metallicRoughness map is a constant
           white image (which made the pearls metallic too).

EarringGoldLeaf.obj/.mtl
  Attribution: "Gold leaf Earring" (https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/gold-leaf-earring-64c4c78a861d45a28aa1b78873b02d14)
               by DineshThennarasan (https://sketchfab.com/dineshthennarasan), licensed under CC BY 4.0. Modified.
  Obtained from: https://github.com/kongsanggun/AR_Randering commit 2add0e0ae54f2679783ec7a352724457b6fd8611,
               public/model/earring/gold_leaf_earring/ (scene.gltf, scene.bin, license.txt)
  Changes: decimated 18,760 -> 6,998 triangles; scaled to 50 mm (metres); both materials replaced by Gold18k.

Short credit line for the demo's credits screen:
